references.text: Jesus uses the same contrast between the greatest and the least, emphasizing that the one who serves is the greatest, which reflects the theme of the servant's subordinate position in relation to the master.
Paul refers to himself and others as "servants of Christ" and "stewards of God's mysteries," based on the principle that the apostle is subordinate to the one who sends him.

In his prayer to the Father, Jesus confirms that he has sent the disciples into the world just as the Father sent him, and that they are not of the world, which underscores the same relationship between sender and sent.
